purpose: Fresh audit-only prospective validation of the deterministically reproduced M10L_H240_C056 + M10N_G013 SHORT candidate, with a brand-new immutable MT5-server start, no historical backfill, and no modification/reset of existing forward monitors.

data.source_resolution: Reuse M8B LATEST/06_symbol_metadata.json mt5_files_root exactly, as used by M10B/M10E.

feature_definitions.macd: TORYS-style MACD fast=6 slow=13 signal=4. MACD line=(EMA6-EMA13)/abs(close)*10000 bps; signal=EMA4(MACD line); histogram=line-signal.
feature_definitions.h1_ret3_bps: (latest fully closed H1 close - H1 close 3 bars earlier)/abs(H1 close 3 bars earlier)*10000.
feature_definitions.causal_context: At each H1 decision/open, use only H1 and D1 bars fully closed at or before that decision.

candidate.entry: Virtual exact M1 open bid at the eligible H1 decision. Exact timestamp required.
candidate.exit: Virtual exact M1 open ask exactly 240 minutes after entry; ask = M1 open + spread_points * point. Exact timestamp required; missing exact exit becomes unresolved data-gap outcome and is never backfilled.
candidate.overlap_rule: While an accepted candidate is within its 240-minute scheduled holding interval, later eligible candidates are recorded as ONE_POSITION_ACTIVE skips. A candidate exactly at the prior scheduled exit time is allowed.

fresh_start_bootstrap.start_freeze_rule: Resolve M8B mt5_files_root; verify all six live CSVs exist; take two identical tail snapshots separated by 2 seconds; verify lag bounds; freeze immutable row-prefix fingerprints; set prospective start to the latest CLOSED M1 server-open timestamp.

review_gates.interpretation: All checkpoints are manual research reviews only. Fresh prospective outcomes may not alter C056/G013 thresholds.
